tasks.summary: Implement public static CeilingTo(decimal value, decimal multiple) in src/Rounding.cs under namespace LoopLab.Rounding, computing the smallest multiple >= value, validating multiple is positive, and preserving the decimal scale of multiple in the result.
Add tests in tests/unit/RoundingTests.cs covering positive values including the exact-multiple boundary case.
Add tests in tests/unit/RoundingTests.cs covering negative values including the exact-negative-multiple boundary case.
Add tests in tests/unit/RoundingTests.cs asserting ArgumentOutOfRangeException with ParamName 'multiple' for zero and negative multiples, and no exception for the smallest positive decimal multiple.
Add tests in tests/unit/RoundingTests.cs verifying the returned decimal's scale via decimal.GetBits matches the scale of the multiple argument, including a zero-scale multiple case.
